definitions.explanation: Employment or tasks one does professionally. Also refers to specific tasks or duties.
A specific piece of work that needs to be done.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}は{何|なん}ですか。
{仕事|しごと}が{終|お}わりました。
{仕事|しごと}が{終|お}わったら、{飲|の}みに{行|い}こう。
examples.english: Let's go for drinks after work.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{仕事|しごと}は{先生|せんせい}だが、{毎日|まいにち}{楽|たの}しく{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: My job is being a teacher, and I enjoy working every day.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{仕事|しごと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I have a lot of work today.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}を{早|はや}く{終|お}わらせたい。
examples.english: I want to finish this task quickly.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{仕事|しごと}をもらった。
{来週|らいしゅう}までに{終|お}わらせなければならない{仕事|しごと}がたくさんある。{週末|しゅうまつ}も{働|はたら}くかもしれない。
examples.english: I have a lot of work that I have to finish by next week. I might work on the weekend too.

notes:
One of the most common nouns in Japanese. Can be used as a verb with する: {仕事|しごと}をする (to work).

Related:
- {仕事中|しごとちゅう} (at work)
- {仕事場|しごとば} (workplace).
